s: Conjure a drill of dark energy on your blade, and rend the armor of foes in front of you.

s: Conjure claws of darkness from the shadows to attack foes, applying a condition to them and pulling them to you. Gain quickness if you strike a foe and gain life force for each struck foe.

s: Perform a huge swing that deals heavy damage. Recharges faster if it hits a downed or low-health foe.
t: Сделайте огромный качели, которые нанесут серьезный ущерб. Заряжает быстрее, если он попадает в пониженного или слабого врага.
